0.1.0.compatibility: The original six kinds retain their existing bounded parameters and exact native TikZ/SVG serialization. New kinds are rejected under this version.

0.2.0.compatibility: Adds narrative and comic-finish geometry through a fixed built-in dispatcher; existing six-kind recipes retain their serializers. The outer recipe fields and native macro names are unchanged.
0.2.0.geometry_only: Fans and tabs expose label anchors as metadata without rendering family text. Finishes supply bounded vector marks; they do not distress glyphs or select identity assets.

0.3.0.compatibility: Adds two bounded technical marks through the fixed dispatcher. Prior versions keep their closed kind sets and prior recipes retain native serializer bytes.
0.3.0.geometry_only: Concentric circles and straight interrupted rules with transparent hollow nodes contain no copy, font, palette or identity decisions.

scope: Local, trusted family-owned LaTeX compositions and optional hash-pinned static web source using shared semantic type roles, native accents, and output evidence.
trusted_source: TeX entries and dependencies are trusted local source. The runner disables shell escape; it does not sandbox arbitrary TeX. Recipes do not select or import executable Python plugins.

source_records.resolution: Paths are relative to the recipe manifest, preserve their declared tree when staged, and must not traverse parents, escape the manifest directory, or pass through symlinks.

fonts.path_resolution: Absolute or recipe-relative existing TTF, OTF, or TTC files with TeX-safe resolved paths.
fonts.semantic_roles: All 17 shared semantic roles must bind to explicitly declared physical faces. Font sizes, colors, and composition remain family-owned.

duplex.scope: Optional logical front/back pairing for one sheet. Works with every supported recipe version and any otherwise valid PDF slot, including null. Existing page count, per-page geometry, and zero-rotation checks still apply.
duplex.evidence: The exact declaration survives in the portable recipe. PDF checks, the per-output build report and rebuild_recipe.duplex record the flip, one sheet and page-to-face map. Outputs without a declaration receive no duplex metadata.
duplex.limits: No page imposition, page rotation, printer configuration, bleed generation or physical print approval is performed. Flip records the intended printer setting; physical_print_review remains pending.

assets.resolution: Manifest-contained, non-symlink source paths retain their declared tree in compile staging and the editable rebuild packet. SHA-256 and PNG readability are verified before output creation.
assets.destinations: Assets may not duplicate source paths or overlap generated.tex, style.json, content.json, assets/sRGB.icc, or the compiled tree.
assets.evidence: Every declared asset is staged and packaged, including unused declarations. Source hashes and origins include it; raster-source representation records preserve exact PNG dimensions, encoded color mode, and no-vector-master status.
assets.editing_boundary: Original raster illustrations remain separate from native editable LaTeX typography, TikZ geometry, and generated SVG accents. JPEG is deferred until the representation validator supports it.

outputs.coverage: Only a selected, machine-checked PDF declaring a light context can contribute to its declared PDF baseline slot. Visual review remains pending. Experimental outputs have a null slot. Optional native web source contributes separately to web-light only at a static-checks-passed-awaiting-browser-review status.
outputs.bindings: PascalCase letter-only keys reference plain string leaves by dotted object keys or list indexes. Each becomes an escaped \Field<Key> macro.
outputs.required_text: A non-empty list of content references checked in the extracted PDF text.
outputs.accents: PascalCase letter-only keys map to kind/width_mm/height_mm/parameters recipes and become \Accent<Key> macros. The explicit recipe_version selects the closed accent_grammars kind set through accent_registry.py; each fixed native helper enforces its own finite physical bounds. No executable module, family asset, font, or palette fallback is selected by accent data.

generated_macros.semantic_roles: TypeIdentityWordmark through TypeFooter, as defined by typography_roles.py
generated_macros.color_profile: SrgbIntent; the full document calls this after begin{document}
generated_macros.data_file: generated.tex; the full document loads it after fontspec, xcolor, and tikz

evidence: static dispatcher and selected native helper hashes
per-accent grammar, serializer, normalized parameters and label anchors
editable ZIP with no font binaries
optional exact-byte native static web source metadata, semantic binding checks and intended browser viewports
guardrails: Existing profile manifests and their renderer remain supported independently.
A machine-checked screen proof is awaiting visual review until separate evidence records that review.
A local proof does not establish typography licensing, browser behavior, print production, or identity approval.

web.availability: Optional, independent of the 0.1.0/0.2.0/0.3.0 accent grammar. Absent declarations retain PDF-only behavior; --no-web omits native web staging and coverage.

source_records.resolution: Exact hash-pinned files must be recipe-relative, non-traversing, non-symlink paths inside the HTML entry directory. They stage relative to that directory under web/ and keep their original tree under recipe-input/.

web.source_subset: UTF-8 balanced HTML with local CSS, passive SVG, PNG geometry and linked PDF signatures. No scripts, inline styles, remote/query/data/parent-traversing references, CSS imports or escapes, active SVG, or font binaries. PNG and linked PDF headers classify exact source; they do not establish successful rendering.
semantic_checks: explicit language, UTF-8 and device viewport
exactly one title, h1 and main; header, nav and footer
required content leaves in HTML body text
local references resolve to declared files and same-document fragments resolve to ids
linked CSS selectors for all 17 roles with font-family: var(--face-PHYSICAL) matching role_map
family-owned declarations for exercised --face-* font stacks
focus-visible rule, responsive media rule and reduced-motion media rule

viewports.rules: Integer distinct widths including a mobile width at most 480 and desktop width at least 1200. These are intended browser test dimensions, not executed tests.

web.typography: css_role_definitions(role_map, type) emits the same 17 semantic mappings used by TeX. The family owns local font names, fallbacks, sizes, spacing and treatment; computed browser font selection needs browser evidence.
web.coverage: Only an included, statically checked web declaration with context light contributes to web-light, at static-checks-passed-awaiting-browser-review. Other contexts and omitted/absent declarations leave that slot not-run.
web.evidence: Separate web-representations.json records exact native HTML/CSS/SVG/PNG source bytes and linked PDF documents. These are not inserted into the PDF-only derived-export representation grammar. Build reports preserve all origins, hashes, intended viewports and pending browser review.
web.review_boundary: Static signals do not establish responsive computed layout, contrast, keyboard behavior, accessibility or browser font selection. Separate exact-byte browser receipts record those checks; this adapter does not execute family code or publish a site.
